text: Found it: the Live tab's watcher has a fixed stream budget of 48 markets and gave each game up to 15 of them, so three games used it all (the screenshot shows 6 games, 3 with a score; the other 3 get only a moneyline). Fix coded and tested: the 48 are now shared across all live games (with many on, each keeps the moneyline plus the few strikes nearest the score), so about 16 games instead of 3. Ships in the next build (v0.114.24, after 0.114.23 finishes). The other screen you sent (+EV tab, Live games only: '12 games linked, 11 markets watched, 0 +EV') is the Pinnacle-vs-Novig lane: it is linked to 12 games but sees 0 bets that beat Pinnacle's price right now; that lane watches one market per game, so it is limited by Pinnacle's feed, not by this budget.
